title: Process lifetimes
description:
Turn process create and exit notifications into a lifetime table.

```
create 4120 notepad.exe (parent 3300) at 10.0 s
create 4188 cmd.exe (parent 3300) at 12.5 s
exit 4120 at 30.0 s -> ran 20.0 s
still running: 4188 cmd.exe
```
hints: A `std::map<unsigned, Event>` of running processes; erase on exit (lesson 4.01).
A real callback runs in the context of the process that is starting, at PASSIVE_LEVEL, and must be quick.
requirements: Events are `(time, kind, pid, parent, image name)`.
Match exits to creates; an exit for an unknown pid is reported (the driver started after it).
Process ids are reused, so remove an entry when it exits.
stretch: Build the parent/child tree of the processes still running.
